usedFor: Lnk.Bio is a link page for your profile, and “Create Link” adds a link while “Delete Link” removes one.

bestTemplate.name: “Create Link” in Lnk.Bio
bestTemplate.why: It adds a new link to your profile, so a new page or offer appears without editing by hand.

watchOut: “Delete Link” in Lnk.Bio removes a link from your profile, so check which link before it runs.
